prompts.roster:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original concept art, six-character lineup for a 2D top-down skill-based soccer game, working title Skill Soccer.
Primary request: create one polished horizontal character lineup on a clean pale warm-gray studio background, exactly six separate full-body original future-city street-league athletes, in one consistent clear hand-painted cartoon 2D game style. These are sports competitors, friendly and energetic.
Subjects left to right:
1. Wind Shuttle: smallest slim agile athlete, short swept teal hair, light cropped sports jacket, teal and cream accents, aerodynamic running sneakers, confident playful stance.
2. Iron Guard: largest broad sturdy athlete, short dark hair, orange and cream padded sports uniform, rounded compact protective forearm boards, broad planted stance; no weapon or carried shield.
3. Arc Light: medium slim athlete, tied purple hair, plum and cream sports jacket, asymmetric technical shooting boot with subtle magenta power seams, precise focused stance.
4. Echo: medium athlete, warm brown skin, curly short hair, ivory and turquoise uniform, small circular pulse bracelets, open supportive stance.
5. Magnet Core: stocky athlete wearing navy and gold sports equipment, compact rounded magnetic hip modules and thick shoes, no gun, grounded silhouette.
6. Jump Point: small nimble athlete, cropped blue-black hair, coral and cream tracksuit with light spring-assisted shin pieces, ready-to-intercept stance.
Style/medium: crisp hand-painted shapes, restrained cel shading, dark navy outlines, simplified forms readable at tiny game scale, original indie game art, 3-head-tall stylized body proportions, no photorealism. Same brush and outline language across all six. Cast of adults.
Composition: each character fully visible head to foot, evenly spaced, zero overlap, aligned feet, generous empty margins. A tiny simple black-and-white soccer ball near the middle character's feet. Orthographic front three-quarter design view for character identity, not gameplay sprites.
Lighting: soft uniform neutral light, no dramatic cast shadows.
Constraints: no logos, no text, no labels, no watermark; no health bars, no weapons, no copied copyrighted characters. Team identifiers will later be independent cyan-circle / amber-diamond overlays, so keep individual outfit colors subtle. Large clear silhouette differences: Iron Guard about 1.4 times Wind Shuttle's width.
prompts.arena:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: background-only PNG for an original 2D top-down future-city street-league soccer arena.
Primary request: a clean empty playable arena with subtle future-city street sports atmosphere, crisp hand-painted cartoon 2D game art, dark navy outlines and restrained cel shading.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9, strict straight-down orthographic camera at 90 degrees, no horizon, no isometric view. The central 80 percent of image width and central 80 percent of image height is a uniformly calm desaturated dark teal-green rectangle of sports flooring, very subtle large floor panels only. ZERO white field markings, zero center circle, zero halfway line, zero football penalty lines, zero logos on the floor. Precise gameplay geometry and markings will be drawn separately as a vector overlay. Flat horizontal rectangular space, strictly symmetric layout around both horizontal and vertical center axes.
Only the outer thin perimeter contains decoration: low modular blue-gray railings, modest cyan and warm amber small light accents in symmetric pairs, four tiny urban planters in symmetric corners, small symmetrical bench clusters outside the floor. Keep left and right middle edges empty for future goal overlays. Nothing intrudes over the central playing floor. No goal artwork yet. Keep all outer structures readable from directly above. Any shadows tiny and equally distributed.
Palette: subdued teal-green floor, slate navy and warm off-white outer trim, cyan and amber only as quiet accents. Floor lowest contrast, perimeter somewhat more detailed.
Constraints: no people, no ball, no gameplay UI, no text, no health bars, no perspective convergence, no city skyline, no crowds, no watermark, no copied franchise visual motifs. Single flat 2D painted background, no bevels that look like isometric tiles.
prompts.wind-shuttle:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE isolated static gameplay sprite PNG on genuine transparent background for a 2D top-down soccer game.
Input images: Image 1 is a CHARACTER IDENTITY AND PALETTE reference only. Do not reproduce its lineup, background, front-facing pose or other characters.
Primary request: render only Wind Shuttle, the FIRST character in the reference lineup: small slim adult athlete, swept teal hair, cream cropped sports jacket with teal trim, dark trousers, light aerodynamic teal-white sneakers. Narrow agile silhouette. No speed trail.
Camera/composition: strict overhead camera looking straight down 90 degrees, orthographic projection. Character stands idle facing NORTH, toward the top of the image. We see crown of hair, tops of shoulders, top of torso, forearms and tops of shoes. Face mostly hidden by the crown, no front portrait view. A recognizable compact top-down sports-game figure. Feet apart and arms at sides, one frame, no walking motion. Full silhouette centered in a square canvas, no cropping, at least 18% clear transparent margin on each side. No body part can touch the canvas edge.
Style: same crisp hand-painted cartoon 2D identity as reference, simplified chunky silhouettes, dark navy outline, restrained two-tone cel shading; readable when the sprite is only 64 pixels tall. Neutral diffuse lighting from above.
Constraints: alpha-transparent backdrop, no floor, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no oval shadow, no ball, no circle or selection marker, no halo, no glow outside silhouette, no text, no watermark, no extra characters, no UI, no checkerboard baked into pixels. One static north-facing sprite only. Keep the overhead view consistent for all characters.
